notes: The copula 'am' goes to אֵלֶיךָ, the prepositional predicate, and the explicit pronoun realized by the suffix on הִנְנִי takes only 'I' — rules 20 and 49 both point that way.

Unlike v. 2 the ASV writes no 'the' before 'prince', so nothing is supplied on that construct; the verse's one written 'the' is the supplied one on אֲדֹנָי (rule 15), with the divine title's suffix unrepresented as elsewhere in the chapter.
